1	"""Count the words of a text: a word is a run of characters between spaces, and a text with no
2	spaces is one word. `count(text)` returns the number."""
3	
4	
5	def count(text: str) -> int:
6	    """The number of words in `text`, split on spaces."""
7	    return len([word for word in text.split(" ") if word])

1	"""A behaviour the module docstring describes."""
2	
3	import unittest
4	
5	import wordcount
6	
7	
8	class WordCount(unittest.TestCase):
9	    def test_tabs_and_newlines_separate_words_too(self):
10	        self.assertEqual(wordcount.count("one\ttwo\nthree four"), 4)
11	        self.assertEqual(wordcount.count("  one  \n\n two "), 2)
12	        self.assertEqual(wordcount.count("alone"), 1)

The test: count("  one  \n\n two ") == 2 with split() → ['one','two'] = 2. Good.
